name: Nether-Stalker Khay’ji
shortDescription: Nether-Stalker Khay’ji, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Consortium agent at Area 52 who assigns the Arklon artifact, reports the Zaxxis break and refers the seeker to Gahruj. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
